research_timing.result_availability: 12:00 UTC on the day after the Eastern tip date; assumed
research_timing.fit_cutoff: Latest 12:00 UTC at or before the saved Sleeper capture
research_timing.quote_evidence: Legacy first_snapshot_utc or first_ou_snapshot_utc paired to the archived Sleeper snapshot; original HTTP response-completion and sportsbook update timestamps are unavailable.
research_timing.bootstrap: Resample entire Eastern slate dates; seed 120; 10000 draws for market comparisons and 20000 for favorite reversals

favorite_reversal.status: retrospective exploratory hypothesis; not an active selection rule

limitations: Historical replay with assumed result availability; pregame-as-of integrity cannot be certified from the retained legacy objects.
Legacy quote timestamps are recorded first-snapshot times, not independently retained HTTP completion or sportsbook update timestamps.
The favorite-reversal rule and below-50-percent split were proposed after inspecting these outcomes; no prospective registration is created.
Small samples span only 14 moneyline/spread slates, 7 totals slates and 8 dates in the 17-game favorite subset.
Reported bootstrap intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for model/strategy selection and multiple comparisons.
Flat one-unit risk uses recorded offered-price payouts without execution, slippage or limit evidence. Series overlap and are never pooled.
No native forecast, bet, grade, parameter or public headline is created or changed by this script.
